title: The Style of Hope
story:
For j-hope, fashion has never been just about wearing beautiful clothes. It is another way to express himself, experiment with different ideas, and show the world different sides of his personality.

His style has always been closely connected to his roots in street dance and hip-hop. Comfortable streetwear, oversized silhouettes, bold colors, playful accessories, and unexpected combinations have all become part of his fashion identity. He is never afraid to experiment, whether that means wearing something colorful and eccentric or choosing a more understated, elegant look.

His distinctive fashion sense even inspired a name of its own among fans: Hobicore. The term describes his colorful, expressive aesthetic, often featuring oversized streetwear, bold patterns, quirky accessories, chunky sneakers, and playful references to pop art and childhood nostalgia. Hobicore is all about having fun with fashion, mixing unexpected pieces, and never being afraid to stand out. And although his style has evolved over the years, that playful spirit remains unmistakably his.

Over the years, his fashion choices have attracted attention far beyond the music industry. In January 2023, he attended Paris Fashion Week and made a memorable appearance at the Louis Vuitton men's show. Later that year, he was named a House Ambassador for the French fashion house, marking an important new chapter in his relationship with luxury fashion.

But even as he entered the world of high fashion, j-hope never left his personal taste behind. In a 2025 interview with Louis Vuitton, he reflected on how his style had changed as he had grown. He also explained that fashion and music are closely connected for him: what an artist wears can change the atmosphere of a performance and the message they communicate.

In 2024, j-hope became part of the Audemars Piguet family. The Swiss luxury watchmaker celebrated its 150th anniversary. He joined the brand's anniversary campaign alongside other creative talents, sharing his perspective on individuality, creativity, and the legacy we leave behind. Later that year, he took part in another special anniversary celebration: "It's Late with John Mayer", a one-night show presented by Audemars Piguet during Dubai Watch Week. As the evening's musical guest, j-hope delivered a live performance of "MONA LISA", bringing his unmistakable energy to the celebration of 150 years of watchmaking.

 Another important part of his fashion story is his relationship with NIGO, the Japanese designer and founder of HUMAN MADE. j-hope had admired NIGO's work for years and was already a fan of HUMAN MADE, a brand he had worn regularly since around 2018.

In November 2025, their shared appreciation for the brand turned into a creative collaboration: HUMAN HOPE. The collection brought together HUMAN MADE's distinctive vintage-inspired streetwear aesthetic and j-hope's own playful identity. Squirrel graphics, special logos, clothing, accessories, and home items made the collection feel personal rather than like a simple celebrity endorsement.

The collaboration continued in 2026 with HUMAN HOPE SEASON 2, released alongside the opening of HUMAN MADE TOKYO in Harajuku. The new collection expanded their shared creative world with denim jackets, sweatshirts, accessories, and the familiar squirrel motifs.

And their partnership reached another milestone in October 2026, when j-hope and NIGO joined forces with Nike to create the Air Force 1 '01 JH. The design revisited the silhouette of the 2001 Air Force 1 and included details that made the sneaker unmistakably personal: j-hope's signature squirrel, special laces, a custom insole, and a specially designed shoebox.

For j-hope, the Air Force 1 also carried a special memory. He explained that white Air Force 1s were the first shoes he wore when expressing music through dance, and that he used to dance in them until they were completely worn out. Seeing his own personality and NIGO's creative vision come together in a sneaker connected to those memories was deeply moving for him.

In 2026, his relationship with Louis Vuitton reached an especially personal milestone: the LV Buttersoft Sneaker, created in collaboration with the House's Men's Creative Director Pharrell Williams. Originally designed as a custom pair for j-hope to wear on the BTS ARIRANG World Tour, the pink-and-white sneakers were created with his needs as a performer in mind. The design also included personal details: the laces feature the words "YOUR, MY HOPE", while a squirrel and an acorn appear in the heel design. Even the color reflects his positive energy. It was more than a signature sneaker: it brought together his personality, his love of sneakers, and his connection to the world of dance.

From streetwear to luxury fashion, from the clothes he loves wearing to collections he helps create, j-hope's style has continued to evolve without losing its connection to who he is.

Fashion is another language through which he expresses himself. And just like his music and dance, it is unmistakably j-hope.

challenge.question: Which designer did j-hope collaborate with on the HUMAN HOPE collection?
challenge.explanation: j-hope collaborated with NIGO, the founder of HUMAN MADE, on the HUMAN HOPE collection. Their shared appreciation for the brand and its creative vision brought the project to life.
